sentences.text:
__ _  CORAM : ASHWIN D. BHOBE, J.
DATED : 18 MARCH 2026 PC:-
1. Heard Mr. Mateen Shaikh, learned Advocate for the Applicant and Mrs. P P Bhosale, learned APP for the Respondent / State.
2. By the present Application, the Applicant is seeking to quash First Information Report bearing Crime No. 529 pf 2025 dated 29 December 2025 for the offences punishable under Sections 223, 274, 276, 123 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 along with Sections 26(2), 26(2)(a), 27(3)(c), 27(3) and 3(1)(zz)(iv) of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006, registered with Malbar Hill Police Station, Mumbai.
(5) APL-494.26.DOCX 3.
Mr. Mateen Shaikh, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the issue involved in the present Criminal Application is pending for consideration before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
He further submits that similar issues are involved in Criminal Writ Petition Nos. 280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 and 4078 of 2025.

sentences.text: He refers to the orders passed in the above said Petitions, wherein this Court has admitted the same and granted interim reliefs.

sentences.text: 4. Mrs. P.P.Bhosale, learned APP for the State/Respondent does not dispute that the issue involved in the present Criminal Application is subject matter of the Petitions, referred by the Applicant in the present Criminal Application.
He submits that the present Criminal Application filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short "BNSS") be tagged along with the aforesaid Petitions.
5. Mr. Mateen Shaikh, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the interim orders granted in the aforesaid Petitions, be also granted in this Criminal Application.
6. Mrs. P P Bhosale, learned APP for the State/Respondent does not object to the said request.
7. In view of the above, further proceedings arising out of Crime No. 529 of 2025 dated 29 December 2025 registered with Malbar Hill Police Station, Mumbai are stayed qua the Applicant.
(5) APL-494.26.DOCX 8. Tag the present Criminal Application along with Criminal Writ Petition Nos. 280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 and 4078 of 2025.
